source_locator.description: In the prison, Vasantha Sena's companion secretly speaks to the guard while carrying a pot; the guard then takes it to Bauthayanan.

translation.english_text: [Prison. Vasantha Sena's companion, carrying a pot, speaks secretly with the prison guard; afterwards the guard takes the pot and gives it to Bauthayanan.]
When the giving god gives, he tears open the roof and gives! Long live Vasantha Sena!
notes: The source proverb is retained through its roof-tearing image rather than replaced by an English proverb.
The source's visible `*` after `தெய்வம்` remains a source-text anomaly upstream and is not silently interpreted here.

source_locator.description: As Bauthayanan unties the bundle, a hooded snake comes out, bites him, and he dies.

translation.english_text: As he unties the bundle, a snake rises with its hood spread, comes out and bites him... Bauthayanan dies.
